 Has Sri Lanka ever won a Test series in Pakistan? PAK vs SL full head-to-head record, series results in red-ball listed
 Deepanjan Mitra
 •

 KEY TAKEAWAYS:
 Sri Lanka have won two Test series in Pakistan , most recently in 1999/2000.
 Pakistan have won four series against Sri Lanka at home, and two were drawn.
 Two Tests in Rawalpindi and Lahore begin on November 9.
 Sri Lanka's Test record in Pakistan 
 The Sri Lankan men’s team is in the middle of a long tour of Pakistan that began in October. The itinerary includes three T20Is, an ODI tri-series with England and two Tests. The tour is due to end on November 21. The two Tests will count towards the World Test Championship 2025-27 cycle. Pakistan are ninth in the standings, while Sri Lanka are seventh.
 Sri Lanka have named a 15-man group for the series, with Kusal Mendis as captain, though Pathum Nissanka's place depends on fitness. Pakistan are led by Babar Azam and have three uncapped batters in Sameer Minhas, Mohammad Taha and Mohammad Suleman.
 This piece sets out the full red-ball history between the two nations, both in Sri Lanka and in Pakistan.

 Two further series were played at neutral venues in the UAE. The 2013/14 series was drawn 1-1, and Sri Lanka won 2-0 in 2017.
 Pakistan vs Sri Lanka Test Series head-to-head record at home
 In Sri Lanka, the hosts have won three of 11 series, drawn three and lost five. Pakistan’s most recent win came in 2023, when they won 2-0, including an innings and 222-run victory in Colombo.

 Pakistan vs Sri Lanka Test Series head-to-head record away from home
 The tourists have played eight Test series on Pakistani soil, and the hosts hold the edge. Pakistan won the first three series, in 1981/82, 1985/86 and 1991/92. Sri Lanka won their two series by 2-1 in 1995/96 and 1999/2000, and the most recent series was a 1-0 Pakistan win in 2019/20.

 Pakistan vs Sri Lanka Test record in Pakistan
 The record below also includes two Asian Test Championship matches in Lahore, drawn in 1998/99 and won by Sri Lanka by eight wickets in 2001/02, which was their last Test win in Pakistan. The 2009 Lahore Test was abandoned after the attack on the Sri Lanka team bus and is recorded as a draw.

 Can Sri Lanka win a Test series in Pakistan again? Chances of both sides
 Pakistan start as slight favourites, but not by a wide margin. They are ninth in the World Test Championship standings, and several of their batters are uncapped. Their home record against Sri Lanka is also thinner than the overall numbers suggest, with nine wins in 23 Tests and eight draws.
 Sri Lanka are under new leadership, with Kusal Mendis now taking over as Test captain. They have experience in Dinesh Chandimal, Dhananjaya de Silva and Kamindu Mendis, and spin options in Prabath Jayasuriya and Keshara Nuwantha. Their problem is history, as they have not won a series in Pakistan for more than 26 years.
 About one in three Tests between the two sides ends in a draw, and a two-match series leaves little room to recover from a slow start. A Pakistan series win or a 1-1 draw looks the most likely outcome, and Sri Lanka will probably need to win the first Test in Rawalpindi, where they last won in 2000.
